integrity: Analytical local-order and Fourier proof with standalone Python 3 numerical/exact checks; all positive-frequency claims are proof-based, not inferred from finite enumeration. The embedded checker has no external scientific dependencies.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random permutations with cyclic positional comparisons, n>=5, unnormalized peak and valley indicators. No nonuniform sampling, nonlinear recovery, independence of Fourier scores, or empirical spectral distribution theorem. Prior priority not independently certified.
title: Sharp two-channel Fourier sampling of cyclic permutation extrema
